title: Beehiiv Review (2026)
intro: Beehiiv is evaluated here as an adjacent email-marketing tool (verification/deliverability — not a core ESP) — Beehiiv is a newsletter growth and publication platform with website hosting, monetization, referrals/boosts, and email sending. Pricing: Launch free up to 2,500 subscribers; Scale from $49/mo ($43/mo annual) and Max from $109/mo ($96/mo annual) at up to 1,000 subscribers on researched calculator bands; Enterprise custom. This review uses SoftwareGlimpse’s email-marketing methodology (ease of use, email creation, automation, segmentation, analytics, deliverability tooling, integrations, scalability, value, AI). It is based on first-party research, not hands-on lab testing.
summary: Choose Beehiiv when newsletter publication growth and monetization are the primary jobs — not classic ecommerce ESP automation.
verdict: Choose Beehiiv when newsletter publication growth and monetization are the primary jobs — not classic ecommerce ESP automation. Compare Kit for creator ESP automations, Flodesk for design-led email, MailerLite for simple free-tier ESP, and Substack-class peers outside this catalogue. Scores reflect first-party documentation as of 2026-08-17 — not hands-on product testing. Confirm current packaging on the vendor site before purchase.

faq.question: Is Beehiiv a full email marketing ESP?
faq.answer: No. Beehiiv is adjacent tooling (verification/deliverability) that complements an ESP. Use GetResponse, Mailchimp, AWeber, or Campaign Monitor to build and send campaigns.
